breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly specifies a Monkhorst-Pack grid with a half shift (8x8x8 grid with half shift) and does not include any gamma-centering instruction. This matches the ground truth, which removes the conflicting gamma-centered requirement and retains only the half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack grid.
